instructor: Her lectures are not so enjoyable and smooth. I do not think she has enough knowledge to answer the questions that come from students. However this was her first year of teaching. I am sure that she tries her best to improve herself. Also she is very kind. I think she will be a good instuctor.

I felt like she did not know what she was teaching, she kept reading power point slides and when students asked questions, instead of answering them, she asked to other students if they knew. But I think she will get better at teaching with a few years since this was the first time she was teaching this course. She was also really respectful to students' point of views and she returned to the mails if we had any questions.  When I asked questions to the course coordinator Bilge Baytekin, she neglected my mails and instead answered disrespectfully without any explanation. I think being a real scientist requires being humble and being able to answer questions scientifically without any ego, which Won mi Ahn was trying her best at.

I think her knowledge of the course topics is not satisfactory. Throughout the course, she occasionally was not able to properly answer questions coming from the students. In these cases, her answers could not extend beyond the information available in the slides. As for the strongest points, she usually ended the lecture earlier, so we did, on average, around 2 hours of lecture per week. Despite the small number of lectures, she was able to cover even more material than the slides available on Moodle.

She has an efficient style of giving lessons. It is pretty easy to keep up with the lectures. Yet, as undergraduates, we had lots of questions in the lectures, I think she has room of improvement for a better understanding what the points of our questions are. She was very well prepared for the lectures tho.

I would like to thank the instructor for the effort shown throughout the entire semester. I believe that the instructor is quite good at reading the slides(only reading); however, I have observed some shortcomings in the actual explanation of the topics. I would also like to note that throughout the semester, the instructor did not write even a single point on the board and relied almost entirely on reading the slides.

I also think that there were some deficiencies in subject mastery. For example, when my classmate asked a question from the homework uploaded to Moodle before the quiz (the electronegativity ranking) during the break, the instructor was not able to solve it and later mentioned that the same question did not appear on the exam. There are several similar examples as well. In class, when a question was asked, the instructor often could not answer it, tended to brush it off, and was unable to provide a satisfactory explanation. These were not isolated incidents; they occurred repeatedly throughout the entire semester.

Of course, instructors are not expected to know everything, and since this was the first time teaching this course, some issues may be understandable; however, I still believe that coming to class with sufficient preparation and subject familiarity is important for students’ learning. After all, we are studying at one of the best universities in the country.

Apart from these points, I have had no personal issues with the instructor, and I believe the instructor is very kind and genuinely well-intentioned toward students. However, when evaluating the course itself, I feel obliged to mention these issues.

The instructor is very thoughtful and helpful.
Sometimes the lectures were in relatively slow pace.
She explains the lesson in a very low voice and in an unengaging way. Coming to class becomes a complete waste of time.

course: I think having cheat sheets would be better. A formula sheet is provided, yes, but there are certain material that needs to be memorized. The quizzes have multiple versions (a, b, c, etc.), and I feel like their difficulties were not equal. When discussing the quiz with my friends, I sometimes found the version my friend had solved to be either easier/harder.

Considering that the lectures were conducted entirely through slides, it is understandable that no questions beyond the Moodle slides are asked. However, the information in these slides is insufficient for exam preparation, and the exams include questions that are a little different in style and scope. It should be better.
I think this is a very necessary course since these subjects are very open to improvements. Also concepts learned in this course is helped me grasp other concepts in chemistry better.

Dersin quiz ve midtermleri ders sunumlarıyla ve eski çıkmışlarla alakasız ve notlandırma çok kıt. Bir konuya kitaptan ve sunumlardan ne kadar çalışmış olsanız da bazı soruların asla olmayacağını kabullenmeniz gerekiyor. Ayrıca sunumları genel olarak açıklayıcı değil.

En olumsuz: 1) Dersin katılım quizinin rastgele bir günde gelip gelmemenize bağlı olması. Ve o “rastgele” günü hocanız seçeceğinden gerçekten rastgele olmaması. 2) 4 quiz olması ve hiçbirinin telafisinin olmaması. 3) Çok fazla konunun iç içe sıkıştırılmış olması.

I think the quizzes are much harder than they need to be. The exams are already difficult, and when you can’t earn points from the quizzes, the course becomes torture. There are also too many overly detailed and difficult topics.

Even though I was well prepared for the quizzes, there happened some questions about the concepts I was never introduced (maybe my fauld idk). The midterms were more within the concept we were tought, but I encountered some concepts in the quizzes for the first time.

Dersi ilgi çekici yapacak hiçbir unsur yok. Bir de ders yükü acayip az. Bu ilk bakışta iyi bir şey gibi gelebilir fakat düzenli çalışma gereksinimi olmadığında öğrenci dersten kopuyor. Onun dışında tüm hocalar dersi slayttan işliyor, slaytlar çok sıkıcı bu yüzden ders anında dersi dinleme hevesi kalmıyor. Son olarak derste işlenen materyal ve sınavlar arasında çok fark var.

Ders slayt ezberleme dersi gibiydi. Kesinlikle cheat sheet olmalı, o kadar çok formül ve bilgi var ki birbirine girmeye başlıyor bir süre sonra ve çekilmez bir hal alıyor. Sınavlardaki sorular kitaptakinden farklıydı ve garipti, ölçücü olduğunu düşünmüyorum. Bazı sorular scientifically olarak yanlış olmasına rağmen düzeltilmedi, sırf uğraşmamak için düzeltmediklerini düşünüyorum, ve bu bilime aykırı bir şey, akademisyen olarak bilimsel doğruluğu kontrol etmeliler. Ayrıca, attendance quiz olayı dersin olumsuz bir tarafı. Hoca her ders slayt okuyorsa derse katılmak zaman kaybı gibi geliyor ve bunu kabul etmeliler. 2 haftada işlenen konuyu 1 günde 70 sayfalık bir slayt okuyarak halledebiliyor herkes. Bu açıdan öğrencileri derse katılmaya zorlamak hatalı bence. Ve unit conversion olayına bu kadar takmaları çok saçma geliyo, sorunun nasıl çözüldüğüne kıyasla unit conversiona nedense daha çok önem veriyolar.
